messages:
elaine: Quick design review — I went through the in-product docs panel on the Routes page and flagged a few things we should align before the release.
michael: thanks! can you gist the top 3? :eyes:
sophie: if it's quick: prefer we discuss here so design/eng sync is captured.
elaine: 1) Terminology mismatch: console UI uses 'model variant' in dropdown, docs pages use 'model flavor' in copy. Causes confusion when users try to cross-reference. Proposal: standardize to 'model variant' everywhere.
kyle: +1 to 'model variant' — matches backend naming. we should also add a help tooltip where we use that term.
elaine: 2) Cross-linking: the docs panel shows a short paragraph about routing policies but no direct anchor to the routing doc. Users have to open docs site and search. Suggest adding a per-section deeplink (anchor) and a small chevron icon that opens the doc at the section.
michael: do we have stable anchor ids on docs site? if not, ops will need to add them.
docs-bot: docs-bot: created PR #489 adding anchors for routing-policy, batching, and kv-cache sections — https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/489 :white_check_mark:
sophie: nice. UX nit: the chevron should be keyboard-focusable and have aria-label="Open docs: routing policy".
elaine: 3) In-panel copy: the primary CTA currently says "Read more" which is vague. Suggest "Open routing docs" or "See routing examples" depending on context.
kyle: prefer action-oriented CTAs. "See routing examples" for the example card, "Open routing docs" for the overview.
michael: accessibility: when the docs panel opens, focus is trapped in the panel but pressing Escape doesn't close it consistently. I reproduced on Firefox.
sophie: I noticed that too — modal role is set but we forgot to listen for ESC in the panel keyboard handler. low effort fix.
elaine: low-risk implementation: add a focus-return hook so after closing we return focus to the original control that opened the panel (e.g., the info icon). also ensure we announce "Panel opened" with aria-live.
kyle: for copy alignment, I'll create a tiny mapping doc: UI term -> docs term -> suggested canonical term. will share a link.
elaine: thanks. final ask: can we include a tiny inline glossary entry at the bottom of the panel for the 3 most-confusing terms (model variant, dedicated capacity, KV cache)? users repeatedly open docs for those.
michael: good idea. maybe collapsed by default to save real estate.
sophie: layout thought: if we add anchors/CTAs, avoid stacking too many buttons horizontally on mobile. probably collapse into a single overflow menu on narrow viewports.
kyle: noted. I'll spin up a spec and post in design channel by EOD. will tag you all.
elaine: awesome — thanks everyone. leaving the doclink to kyle when ready. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Design review thread on in-product docs panel: standardize 'model variant' term, add section anchors/deeplinks to docs, improve CTAs, fix ESC focus behavior and aria-live announcements, add mini-glossary and mobile layout considerations. docs-bot reported PR for anchors.
